verses.1: A psalm of David. The LORD is my shepherd; I lack nothing.
verses.2: He sets me to rest in fields of fresh grass, he leads me beside still waters.
verses.3: He restores my soul. He guides me along the pathways of righteousness for the sake of his name.
verses.4: Even when I walk through the valley of deep shadow, I fear no harm, for you are with me—your rod and your staff, they comfort me.
verses.5: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my adversaries; you anoint my head with oil, and my cup overflows.
verses.6: Surely goodness and steadfast love will pursue me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the house of the LORD for the length of days.

notes:
Notes
- v. 3: "the pathways of righteousness" reflects the meaning of "ma'agalei tzadek" as paths or circles of righteousness, not necessarily "paths of justice" in a legal sense.
- v. 4: "the valley of deep shadow" translates "gai tselmavet," which literally means "valley of the shadow of death," but is rendered here to avoid archaic phrasing while preserving the imagery.
- v. 5: "adversaries" is used for "tsorrai" to convey the sense of opposition without assuming a specific context.
